help: The functions that render, merge and read PDF files. `Novis\Pdf\Document` calls them for you, so most programs use `Document` instead.

methods.name: render

params.name: document
params.type: { html: string, assets: array<{ name: string, data: bytes }>, options: { standard: ?Standard, password: ?string, invoiceXml: ?string, created: ?Core\Time\Instant } }

methods.returns: { data: bytes, pageCount: uint, pages: array<{ number: uint, name: ?string, strings: array<{ name: string, value: string }>, marks: array<{ name: string, value: string }> }>, dropped: array<{ property: string, value: string, selector: string, line: uint, column: uint }>, missingGlyphs: array<{ text: string, fonts: array<string>, page: uint }>, overflows: array<{ page: uint, area: string, text: string }> }
methods.help: Renders an HTML document to a PDF file. Returns the file, its pages, and what the render could not draw.

methods.name: renderFirst

params.name: pass
params.type: { document: { html: string, assets: array<{ name: string, data: bytes }>, options: { standard: ?Standard, password: ?string, invoiceXml: ?string, created: ?Core\Time\Instant } }, headerHeight: ?string, footerHeight: ?string }

methods.returns: { body: Kept, facts: { data: bytes, pageCount: uint, pages: array<{ number: uint, name: ?string, strings: array<{ name: string, value: string }>, marks: array<{ name: string, value: string }> }>, dropped: array<{ property: string, value: string, selector: string, line: uint, column: uint }>, missingGlyphs: array<{ text: string, fonts: array<string>, page: uint }>, overflows: array<{ page: uint, area: string, text: string }> } }
methods.help: Lays out the body of a document that has header, footer or slot functions. Returns the laid-out body and the facts of each page. The file is empty.

methods.name: renderSecond

params.name: margins
params.type: { pages: array<{ header: ?string, footer: ?string, slots: array<{ name: string, value: string }> }> }

methods.returns: { data: bytes, pageCount: uint, pages: array<{ number: uint, name: ?string, strings: array<{ name: string, value: string }>, marks: array<{ name: string, value: string }> }>, dropped: array<{ property: string, value: string, selector: string, line: uint, column: uint }>, missingGlyphs: array<{ text: string, fonts: array<string>, page: uint }>, overflows: array<{ page: uint, area: string, text: string }> }
methods.help: Draws the markup of each page on a body from `renderFirst`, and returns the PDF file. Each body is written once.

methods.name: merge
methods.help: Returns one PDF file with the chosen pages of each part, in order. An encrypted part throws a `ParseError`. Every stream in the file decompresses to at most `maxBytes` bytes, and to at most `maxRatio` times its compressed size. The server sets both from `[limits]`.

methods.name: read
methods.returns: { file: Reading, pageCount: uint, metadata: { title: ?string, author: ?string, subject: ?string, keywords: ?string, creator: ?string, producer: ?string }, attachments: array<{ name: string, data: bytes }>, invoiceXml: ?string }
methods.help: Opens a PDF file. Returns the file for `readText`, and its page count, its metadata and its attached files. Every stream in the file decompresses to at most `maxBytes` bytes, and to at most `maxRatio` times its compressed size. The server sets both from `[limits]`.

methods.name: readText
methods.help: Returns the text of each page in `pages` of a file from `read`. Pages count from 1. Every stream in the file decompresses to at most `maxBytes` bytes, and to at most `maxRatio` times its compressed size. The server sets both from `[limits]`.

enums.name: Standard
enums.help: A PDF standard the file follows. `PdfA2b` and `PdfA3b` are for archiving, and `PdfUa1` is for screen readers.
